title: Identity verification
intro: Complete eKYC so BuildMate can confirm the contractor profile belongs to its owner. The result is sent to an administrator for review.
frontHint: Keep all four corners inside the frame. Avoid glare and keep the portrait and text sharp.
backHint: Capture the full back side without cropped corners or glare.
invalidImage: Use a JPG, PNG, or WEBP image within the size limit.
cameraDenied: Camera permission is blocked. Allow it and try again.
cameraError: The camera could not be opened.
faceLead: The camera checks center, left, right, up, and down. A step continues only after the server accepts it.
resultTitle: Details read from the ID card
submitted: The profile was sent for administrator review.
needSubmit: Finish eKYC and send it before leaving this step.
resumeFace: This verification session is not finished. Please repeat the face step.
unavailable: The verification service is unavailable. Please try again.

codes.MULTIPLE_FACES: Only one person can be in the frame.
codes.WRONG_POSE: That pose was not accepted. Try this angle again.
codes.SPOOF: A photo or screen was detected. Use a live face.
codes.DIFFERENT_FACE: The frames are not the same person.
codes.UNKNOWN: The check could not be completed. Try again.
